articles.title: Polygon taps TRON’s $94 billion stablecoin supply for seamless cross-border transfers
articles.snippet: Polygon said businesses can also move the world’s largest stablecoin USDT between TRON and EVM networks without connecting to a wallet provider, bridge or fiat-ramp operator.

articles.title: Quantum computers threaten exposed private keys rather than blockchains, Europol warns
articles.snippet: EU law enforcement agencies urged developers, exchanges, and users to initiate phased post-quantum migrations immediately to prevent future unauthorized fund transfers.

articles.title: Chasing 100x tokens is game of ‘irrational exuberance,’ says Polymarket CEO
articles.snippet: Some traders are looking for more predictable prediction market opportunities, rather than playing “hot potato” with the next 100x gem, according to Polymarket’s Shayne Coplan.

articles.title: ECB policymaker warns of fragmentation without digital euro
articles.snippet: A ECB executive board member said the potential introduction of a digital euro would not ”take over the role of banks,” but ensure they have a role in the EU’s monetary system.

articles.title: Europol Warns Crypto Wallets Are 'Primary Risk' for Quantum Attacks
articles.snippet: The EU police agency expects blockchains to adapt to the threat, while a second report weighs the risk of data stolen now and cracked later.
